MX-C1.name: Finite unramified extensions and decomposition modulo inertia
MX-C1.statement_used: For a complete discretely valued field with finite residue field, finite unramified extensions correspond to finite residue extensions; the inertia quotient is the residue Galois group. Passing to compatible finite extensions gives procyclic quotient generated by arithmetic Frobenius.
MX-C1.source: J.S.Milne, Algebraic Number Theory, version3.08, Proposition7.50, Corollary7.52, Remark7.53 and subsequent finite-residue discussion, Theorem7.58(a).
MX-C1.matching: Used only on the chosen original D.pl(q). KB6 supplies henselization/completion equivalence and inertia/cochain compatibility. Conjugacy of places is used on finite normal extensions and passed through their inverse limit; no new place or field is substituted.

MX-C2.name: Hochschild-Serre spectral sequence, finite-normal-subgroup specialization
MX-C2.statement_used: For finite G and normal N, group cohomology has the cochain-filtration spectral sequence with E2(p,q)=H^p(G/N,H^q(N,V)). When order(N) is invertible on V, averaging kills all positive q and inflation identifies cohomology with that of G/N on V^N.
MX-C2.source: G.Hochschild and J.-P.Serre, Cohomology of group extensions, Trans.Amer.Math.Soc.74(1953),110-134, ChapterII Theorems1-2, especially printed p125.
MX-C2.matching: MX2 proves the passage through finite continuous cochains and the cyclic H2 vanishing directly. I/N is finite of order prime to ell; coefficients are the exact finite residual-adjoint module tensor the small kernel. No unrelated pro-ell duality or local smoothness theorem is substituted.

MX-C3.name: Noetherian formal power series and complete local quotients
MX-C3.statement_used: Finite-variable formal power series over a Noetherian ring are Noetherian; a quotient of a complete Noetherian local ring by a proper ideal is complete Noetherian local. Krull intersection is zero for powers of a proper ideal on a finite module over a Noetherian local ring.
MX-C3.source: Stacks Project, Lemma10.31.2 tag0306; Lemma10.160.2 tag0325; Lemma10.51.4 tag00IP.
MX-C3.matching: Applied to the explicit finite formal-series cover and proper quotients whose origins survive. In MX2 a descending chain of subspaces of the finite small kernel stabilizes, and Krull intersection makes its stable term zero. FP1 already provides the automatic continuity and IsCO conventions.
